extension.author: Björn Rudner
extension.label: Datamodel: Risk Assessment
extension.description: Adds the ability to document risk parameters on CIs.
extension.version_description: Requires iTop 3.3.0 or later. Integrates risk and recovery fields into the native detail layouts, makes repeated audit setup safe, and corrects the non-repudiation audit rule while preserving customized queries. An optional bridge displays System Landscape on the application solution portal form.
